data.one_liner: A customizable Flutter widget that synchronizes a Slider and a TextField.
data.what_it_does: Combines a TextField and a Slider into a single component, keeping their values synchronized so changes to one instantly update the other. It also supports grouping multiple sliders together inside an InputSliderForm with shared styling and alignment.
use_when: You need precise numeric input alongside a visual slider control.
You want to group and align multiple sliders and text fields in a form.
avoid_when: You only need a standard standalone Slider or TextField without synchronization.
strengths: Synchronizes Slider and TextField values automatically.
Supports grouping and aligning multiple inputs with InputSliderForm.
weaknesses: Limited to a combined slider and text input use case.
data.minimal_example:
InputSlider(
  onChange: (value) => print("change: $value"),
  min: 0.0,
  max: 100.0,
  decimalPlaces: 0,
  value: 50.0,
  leading: Text("Percentage:"),
)
